name: TensorWave

source.quote: Its valuation of $1.55 billion is more than four times the roughly $400 million valuation reportedly linked to TensorWave’s $100 million Series A in May 2025.

description: Las Vegas-based AI cloud built entirely on AMD Instinct GPUs.
explain: TensorWave is AMD's showcase cloud: it runs only AMD GPUs and AMD's venture arm co-led its funding rounds, so AMD money helps buy AMD chips.
